gloss: to burn, to be on fire

definitions.gloss: to burn, to be on fire

definitions.explanation: To feel strong enthusiasm or emotion (figurative).

notes:
{燃|も}える means to burn or be on fire. Also used figuratively for passion or enthusiasm.

TRANSITIVITY:
- {燃|も}える (intransitive): to burn, be on fire
- {燃|も}やす (transitive): to burn something

CONJUGATION (ichidan):
- {燃|も}えない (negative)
- {燃|も}えます (polite)
- {燃|も}えた (past)
- {燃|も}えて (te-form)

COMMON USES:
- {火|ひ}が{燃|も}える: the fire burns
- {家|いえ}が{燃|も}える: the house is on fire
- {闘志|とうし}が{燃|も}える: fighting spirit burns
- {情熱|じょうねつ}に{燃|も}える: to burn with passion
- {燃|も}えるような{恋|こい}: a burning love

RELATED COMPOUNDS:
- {燃|も}えるゴミ: combustible garbage
- {燃料|ねんりょう}: fuel
- {燃焼|ねんしょう}: combustion
- {可燃|かねん}: flammable, combustible

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {焼|や}ける: to burn, be scorched (often implies damage)
- {炎上|えんじょう}する: to go up in flames
